title: AI Product Operations Lead
location: Germany (Remote); Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote); Portugal (Remote); Spain (Remote); United Kingdom (Remote)
description:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal or The Netherlands

About the team

Product Operations sits at the center of how our Product and wider R&D teams work. We help create the systems, practices, and connections that allow teams to focus on solving the right problems and delivering great products.

AI is becoming an increasingly important part of that work. Across R&D, teams are already experimenting with tools like Glean and Claude, building automations, testing agents, and finding new ways to use AI throughout the product development lifecycle.

The opportunity now is to turn that energy into something more systematic.That's where you come in.

About the role

We're looking for an AI Product Operations Lead to build and operate the internal AI Operations capability for R&D.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can take an ambiguous opportunity and turn it into a reliable, adopted solution. You'll help us identify the highest-value problems AI can solve, understand how people work today, design the right solution, build or coordinate its delivery, and then stay accountable for how it performs after launch.

One day, you might be working with a team to understand a frustrating workflow and deciding whether a simple prompt, automation, integration, agent, or internal app is the right answer. The next, you could be improving an existing AI workflow, testing its reliability, helping coordinate access to an enterprise AI tool, or working with IT and InfoSec to make sure a new solution can scale responsibly.

You'll own the connective layer between AI strategy and day-to-day execution across R&D.

This isn't a role for someone who only wants to prototype prompts, manage project plans, or write requirements. We're looking for someone who enjoys combining systems thinking, AI fluency, user discovery, technical execution, and operational ownership—and who wants to see things through.

You'll report to our VP of Product Operations and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, IT, InfoSec, and other AI practitioners across Typeform.

What you'll do

- Build and continuously improve our backlog of AI opportunities across R&D, helping teams identify, prioritize, and sequence the jobs where AI can have the greatest impact.

- Take ambiguous problems from initial discovery through to delivery: understand the user and workflow, explore options and trade-offs, design the right system, build or coordinate implementation, test, document, launch, measure, and improve.

- Design simple, AI-native solutions that fit naturally into how people work. You'll know when a prompt is enough—and when the problem calls for a workflow, integration, agent, database, or custom application.

- Help R&D get more value from enterprise AI tools such as Glean and Claude, partnering with IT and InfoSec on areas including access, configuration, connectors, enablement, and support.

- Own the lifecycle of the AI systems within your portfolio, including automations, skills, agents, and internal web applications.

- Establish practical approaches to evaluation, testing, reliability, observability, security, and maintenance—using evidence and feedback to improve systems over time.

- Partner with teams across R&D to uncover needs, unblock delivery, clarify ownership, and bring the right experts into the work.

- Help run and evolve our R&D AI governance and enablement practices, giving leaders better visibility into active work, risks, adoption, and outcomes.

- Participate in Typeform's broader AI governance efforts as an R&D contributor.

- Work with Finance and other partners to improve visibility into AI tool usage, spend, and value, helping inform investment decisions.

- Explore and support the development of autonomous agents that can improve how we plan, discover, design, build, evaluate, and manage work across the product development lifecycle.

What you'll bring

- Strong practical experience applying AI to real-world problems—not just experimenting with models, but building solutions that people actually use.

- A track record of taking ambiguous problems from discovery through implementation, testing, adoption, and ongoing improvement.

- Excellent systems thinking. You can understand how people, processes, tools, data flows, integrations, permissions, and technical constraints fit together—and make thoughtful trade-offs between different approaches.

- Strong user and workflow discovery skills. You know how to get beyond the initial request, understand the real job to be done, and simplify a solution when the original approach is more complex than it needs to be.

- Hands-on technical fluency and comfort building, modifying, and troubleshooting internal workflows, automations, agents, or applications.

- Practical experience with modern development practices and tools such as GitHub, repositories and pull requests, basic application hosting, deployment, logging, and operational troubleshooting.

- Experience managing work independently: prioritizing a backlog, handling dependencies and risks, documenting decisions, and communicating clearly with stakeholders.

- A strong approach to evaluation and reliability. You think about what "good" looks like, how to test for it, how to collect feedback, and how to improve a system after it goes live.

- The ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. You're comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, seeking expert input, and making progress without needing close day-to-day direction.

- Good judgment around responsible AI, security, access, and governance, and an understanding of when to bring in the right partners.

*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.

title: Senior Paid Marketing Strategist
location: Germany (Remote); Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote); Portugal (Remote); Spain (Remote); United Kingdom (Remote); Europe
description:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Strategist to help us rethink how Typeform approaches paid acquisition.

You’ll own and grow key channels including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads, while helping us test new opportunities across areas such as audio and CTV.

This is a hands on role with real ownership. You’ll manage significant media budgets, build channel strategy, develop campaigns, work closely with our creative teams, and help us understand the true business impact of our investment through MMM, incrementality testing and other measurement approaches.

You’ll join the Acquisition team within Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Product Marketing, Data, RevOps and Finance.

What you’ll do

- Own the strategy and day to day performance of key paid social and display channels, including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads.

- Build a multichannel strategy that helps Typeform reduce its reliance on paid search and find new sources of efficient growth.

- Manage six figure monthly media budgets, making decisions based on customer acquisition, revenue, CAC and LTV to CAC performance.

- Build, launch and optimise campaigns that drive Typeform signups and new paid customers.

- Turn creative ideas into campaigns by briefing and partnering closely with copywriters and designers.

- Run A/B tests across creative, copy, landing pages, placements, audiences and bidding strategies.

- Explore and test new channels such as audio and CTV.

- Own and develop our paid marketing measurement approach, including Marketing Mix Modelling, incrementality studies and alternative measurement frameworks.

- Design experiments that help us understand the incremental impact of our campaigns rather than relying solely on traditional attribution.

- Work closely with our Tracking and Data teams to strengthen our measurement capabilities as digital advertising continues to change.

- Share insights, results and recommendations across Marketing and the wider business.

- Contribute to Typeform’s broader full funnel acquisition strategy across demand creation and demand capture.

What we’re looking for

- Around six or more years of hands on and strategic experience in performance marketing and media buying.

- Strong experience managing paid social and video channels, ideally including TikTok, YouTube and Meta.

- Experience owning campaigns from initial idea and creative brief through implementation, optimisation and measurement.

- A track record of managing six figure budgets and delivering efficient performance.

- Experience working with MMM, incrementality testing or other measurement methods beyond traditional attribution.

- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with campaign performance, conversion funnels, CAC and LTV.

- A strong understanding of digital measurement, from tagging and attribution through to incrementality.

- Experience developing creative and UGC assets for paid social channels.

- The ability to balance creative thinking with strong commercial judgement.

- Curiosity and a willingness to figure things out. When you do not know the answer, you know how to find it, whether that means speaking to the right person, digging into documentation or using AI tools.

- Confidence working across teams and influencing partners in Creative, Product Marketing, Data and Finance.

- Comfort operating with uncertainty. You are happy testing ideas, learning from the results and changing direction when the data tells you to.

Nice to have

- Experience working in SaaS or B2B lead generation.

- Experience across sales technology or marketing technology.

- Experience managing external agencies or digital production partners.

- Experience with ad servers and campaign trafficking.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
⭐ Who we are
 
Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology. 
 
Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.

⭐️ Role Overview
As a Senior Backend Developer in our Reservations Squad, you will take ownership of the financially critical heart of Lodgify’s platform—the booking lifecycle, financial calculations, and real-time availability calendar. You will tackle technical challenges head-on by advancing our event-driven architecture and completing critical database migrations while playing a key role in raising the bar for engineering reliability and team mentorship.

⭐ How will you make an impact?
- Architect and evolve the booking core, managing the end-to-end lifecycle, quotes, taxes, fees, and financial ledger logic.

- Drive event-driven messaging using RabbitMQ outbox/inbox patterns and Kafka (Avro) to guarantee reliable data fan-out across payments, messaging, and channel managers.

- Lead the architectural transition from EF6/SQL Server to EF Core 8/PostgreSQL, executing zero-downtime schema updates that pave the way for continuous delivery.

- Decouple high-churn aggregates by strengthening anti-corruption boundaries and isolating cross-domain communication.

- Optimize our calendar backend-for-frontend service to deliver real-time availability and overbooking protection under strict latency requirements.

- Elevate system reliability by defining SLOs, implementing robust idempotency patterns, and refining observability in Datadog.

- Empower and mentor fellow engineers through constructive peer reviews, architectural documentation, and shared ownership of critical systems.

⭐ What makes you a great fit?
- 7+ years of professional experience building scalable backend services in C# and .NET Core / .NET 8.

- 3+ years of proven hands-on experience designing and operating distributed, event-driven architectures with RabbitMQ or Kafka.

- Deep practical knowledge of database internals, Entity Framework / EF Core, and executing zero-downtime schema migrations on PostgreSQL or SQL Server.

- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CQRS, onion/layered architecture, and Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL) patterns.

- Strong focus on operational excellence, testing, logging/APM instrumentation (Datadog), and idempotency design.

- A collaborative mindset focused on mentoring teammates, writing clear documentation, and solving complex problems pragmatically.

⭐ How can you earn extra bonus points?
- Experience working in a microservices architecture.

- Knowledge use of DevOps tech. (K8s, Docker, Helm, GCP, ...).

Why you’ll love us:
You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.
 
What's in it for you?
🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home.
🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August.
🛡️ Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.
💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for meal costs (up to €220/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).
🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.
🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.
🤑 Referral Program: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.
✈️ Annual Offsite: We bring the whole team together in Barcelona once a year for an unforgettable company offsite!
🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.
 
So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!
All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

title: Product Designer
description:
What are we looking for?

We are seeking a highly motivated Product Designer to join our team. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about user experience and design, eager to learn, and excited to work in a dynamic and fast-paced startup environment. You should be able to take direction well, but also be confident in bringing your own ideas to the table.

Requirements
-
A portfolio showing your thinking, design decisions, interaction craft, and impact on real products—not just final screens.

-
Experience taking digital product work from ambiguous problems to launched experiences.

-
Strong skills in prototyping, UI systems, information architecture, and interaction design, working with and without AI.

-
Solid user-centered design practice: knowing when to research, what to test, and how to turn findings into decisions.

-
Ability to make dense, complex interfaces understandable while preserving advanced functionality.

-
Strong written and verbal communication and comfort collaborating asynchronously with engineers and product stakeholders.

-
A technical mindset and a willingness to learn. You should be curious about SQL, APIs, data models, infrastructure, and the constraints behind the UI or any of the surfaces of our product.

-
Unafraid of and effective at using AI to write your own PRs and/or build fast prototypes.

-
Ownership, initiative, attention to detail, and comfort working with ambiguity in a fast-moving team.

Some other things that are important to us:

-
You are fluent in English.

-
You communicate well in writing. This is important mostly because we favor asynchronous work.

-
You like technical software and are curious about real time data and its usage.

-
Experience designing developer tools, data platforms, databases, observability, analytics, cloud infrastructure, or other technical B2B products.

-
Familiarity with SQL editors, schema explorers, API tooling, query execution, performance feedback, or infrastructure consoles.

-
Ability to build functional prototypes and comfortable with modern AI-assisted prototyping and coding tools.

-
Experience designing complex workflows across CLI, API, documentation, and graphical interfaces.

-
Experience measuring activation, task completion, usability, and adoption after launch.

-
Experience with accessibility and responsive interfaces in data-dense products.

-
Ideally based in Spain, Europe or the UK.

What you’ll do in this role
As a Product Designer, you will work closely with our designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to create designs that are both functional and aesthetic. Your responsibilities will include:

-
Own end-to-end design for key Tinybird RawTree experiences, from problem framing and user flows to polished interactions and production.

-
Simplify the journeys that matter: getting started, connecting and exploring data, writing and testing queries, building APIs, understanding errors, and operating workloads.

-
Design for different levels of technical expertise without taking control or power away from experienced developers.

-
Work directly with product and engineering to explore trade-offs, prototype quickly, and make pragmatic decisions.

-
Conduct lightweight user interviews, usability tests, and feedback sessions; combine qualitative evidence with product usage to prioritize improvements.

-
Create information architecture, interaction patterns, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and interactive prototypes.

-
Build and evolve reusable components and a coherent design system that can scale as Tinybird RawTree grows.

-
Design clear system states, permissions, onboarding, empty states, loading, errors, observability, and actionable feedback—not just the happy path.

-
Help customers understand the relationship between existing Tinybird workflows and RawTree, including transitions where relevant.

-
Contribute to developer-facing touchpoints such as documentation, examples, and product education when they are part of the user experience.

-
Define success with the team, ship, observe what happens, and iterate.

We’re an early-stage startup, and pace and quality of execution are paramount to our success. We understand that startups aren’t for everyone, and that’s okay. As we say at Tinybird, “Speed Wins.” We don’t dither in endless meetings. We execute, analyze our performance, and adjust going forward.

Why Tinybird RawTree?
Tinybird RawTree is a chance to shape a foundational product experience, not simply polish an established interface. You’ll help decide how sophisticated data capabilities become approachable, productive, and reliable for developers. Your work will influence both the product’s direction and the day-to-day experience of the people using it.

Some bits about the way we work
-
We are a remote-friendly company, all of our previous companies were remote-friendly companies, and we intend to remain a remote-friendly company.

-
Our head office is located in Madrid, we love to see each other and work face to face regularly, feel free to go whenever it suits you.

-
We are just starting up so your work will impact everything we do. We also believe in full transparency, and you will always know what is going on.

Check out our blog or follow us on LinkedIn to learn more about what matters to us.

This role includes both cash compensation and a stock options grant. You can find our typical starting salary ranges for this role listed above. The final offer within this range will take into account several factors, including candidate experience, qualifications, skills, business needs, and geographical location.
 
We also offer:
22 days of holiday a year (plus your birthday and public holidays)... but, who is counting?
Work remotely, but we love to go to the Madrid office on Wednesdays. Freedom to work from wherever suits you best. 
Flexible office hours. At Tinybird we do not have fixed office hours. You manage your own time

title: Customer Service Agent: Korean (00:00 am- 8:00am)

Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

We love our customers and always aim to provide the best service. If you like working at home, this job is for you!

INFO: The Schedule for the afternoon-shift position is 00:00 am to 8:00 am (5 days/week) with 1 hour of break.

You will be expected to:

- Customer Service by phone, e-mail or social media for solving any incidents generated daily. All three are essential for resolving any incidents that arise on a daily basis.

- Managing and efficiently handling incoming calls and chats will be a critical aspect of this role to ensure efficient and high-quality communication with clients

- Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools

- Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution. Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts, and file documents

- Follow communication procedures, guidelines, and policies

- Take the extra mile to engage customers

- As the resolutions of incidents are not constant, parallel work for the Department of Operations will be performed.

- Work schedule: 00:00 am - 8:00 am with 1 hour of break

About you:

- Previous experience in User Support or Customer Service positions are highly valuable.

- Previous experience using Zendesk is preferred.

- High Korean level (oral & written) and fluent in Spanish or English

- Skilled at planning, organizing, prioritizing and executing simultaneous tasks.

- Have good communication and interpersonal skills.

- Are a solution-oriented and reliable professional.

- Are incredibly detail-orientated with excellent time-management skills.

- Are flexible. Everything can change very quickly and you know how to adapt

- Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

- Be decisive and organized.

- Love being part of a dynamic team in a growing company.

- Candidates must reside in Spain

You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble and learn, and can work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

This role is located in Spain.

Benefits & Perks

- Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance

- Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader

- 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences

- Work in a location in the heart of Madrid, with possible travel across our markets

- Home-office friendly

- Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth

- Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

- Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee

- English and Spanish Lessons

- Gympass membership

- We have free food, drink and fruit at the office!

- Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu | TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

This role will be focused on understanding and reducing the security risk of Fever's cloud infrastructure and data. You will run technical risk assessments of our AWS environments, data platforms and new architectures, identify the weaknesses that could lead to a security incident or a data breach, and work with the owning teams until those risks are fixed.

As part of the Cybersecurity team, you will focus on defensive security in cloud and data environments: where our sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, how it is protected, and how secure the infrastructure underneath is. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact in a high-growth global category leader, working alongside experts to implement best practices and innovative security solutions. If you're passionate about cloud and data security and enjoy tackling challenges in a dynamic environment, we’d love to have you on board!

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

- You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.

- You will have met the departments of Fever.

- You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, data platforms, architecture, etc.)

- You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools, risk methodology and overall security landscape.

After 3 months in Fever:

- You will run infrastructure and architecture risk assessments using our risk methodology.

- You will map where sensitive data is stored and processed (S3, databases, data warehouse, SaaS) and who can access it.

- You will participate in security configuration reviews to ensure cloud and data environments meet industry standards.

- You will develop automation to detect data exposure, excessive permissions and misconfigurations.

- You will participate in vulnerability management sessions, collaborating with stakeholders to drive continuous security improvements.

On your 6th month in Fever:

- You will own the risk assessment process for infrastructure and data, from design reviews to risk acceptance.

- You will drive the remediation of the main data and infrastructure risks with clear owners and deadlines.

- You will lead initiatives to implement secure solutions for data: classification, encryption and key management, and least-privilege access.

- You will act as a point of contact for technical guidance on cloud architecture, data security and configurations.

- You will develop cybersecurity technical documentation and secure best practices guidelines to educate and support stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

- Perform technical risk assessments and threat models of cloud infrastructure, data platforms and new architectures, and document residual risk.

- Maintain the infrastructure and data risk register, prioritising risks and tracking treatment plans with owners.

- Identify, classify and protect sensitive data across AWS services, data warehouses and SaaS (data security posture).

- Review and enforce encryption, key management (KMS), network isolation and identity and access controls for data stores.

- Conduct regular security assessments to identify vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in the AWS ecosystem.

- Develop and deploy automated security solutions to detect, report and remediate data exposure and misconfigurations.

- Collaborate with Data, DevOps and engineering teams to build security into data pipelines and infrastructure.

About you

Must have:

- Proven experience performing security risk assessments of cloud infrastructure and architectures (threat modeling, likelihood/impact, residual risk).

- Strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure security including IAM, networking, KMS, S3, logging and organisation-level controls.

- Good understanding of data security: data classification, encryption, access governance and data loss prevention.

- Experience securing data platforms (e.g. data lakes, Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks or similar) and their pipelines.

- Proficiency in scripting for automation and security operations (Python, Go or similar).

- Knowledge of risk and cloud security frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM).

- Ability to work cross-functionally and explain risk to technical and business audiences.

- 3+ years of experience in cloud security and/or cybersecurity roles.

- Bachelor or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or another similar relevant degree (or equivalent experience in a technical security role).

- Fluent in English.

- Good communication skills.

It would be a plus if you have:

- Experience with the use of AI and agentic processes to enhance efficiency and provide stronger technical capabilities.

- Experience with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), CNAPP or CSPM tools.

- Familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).

- Knowledge of privacy regulations affecting data (GDPR) and PCI DSS.

- Security certifications (e.g. CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, CRISC, CISSP or similar).

title: Senior Back-End Engineer
description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

 


MEET THE TEAM!

Join Preply’s Teams and help us power people’s progress through life-changing learning experiences. We’re on a mission to combine the magic of the best tutors with cutting-edge AI to create personalized journeys that keep learners motivated and inspired. Together, we’ll transform how students expand their vocabulary, master conversational fluency, and deepen comprehension - unlocking their full potential and sparking a lifelong love for learning. Are you ready to make an impact? Let’s redefine education!

The Preply Engineering Team provides the tools to help unlock human potential through learning.

We implement A/B tests to prove the value of our initiatives and improve our product based on data and students and tutors feedback. As part of our commitment to ensuring high-quality products, we prioritize monitoring and metrics analysis to identify areas for optimization and ensure our services are performing at their best. 

We are tech-agnostic, meaning we are open to considering candidates with diverse technology backgrounds, such as Java/Spring, Node.js/Express.js, Ruby/Ruby on Rails, Scala/Play, PHP, or Golang.

While Python is our primary programming language, prior experience with it is not mandatory. What truly matters is your enthusiasm for learning Python and your ability to adapt quickly to using it for product development.

At Preply, we release our product 50-60 times per day by leveraging top-notch CI/CD processes. As a fast-growing company we have diverse technical challenges (sometimes we even write about them on our Engineering Blog) that will allow you to develop your skills at scale. 

We’ve reached 90%+ adoption of AI coding tools across engineering, and we’re now moving towards more autonomous, AI-Augmented development at scale. At Preply, engineers have direct access to the best tools available, with the freedom to use them fully and experiment as they build





WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You will work in a cross-functional team alongside the Product Manager, Product Designer, UX Writers, Data Analytics, Technical Leads, Engineers and other cross-functional team members to deliver engaging features through A/B tests and build top-notch products, including, but not limited to:

 - Develop and own backend features using Python/Django, supporting the creation of new backend services as well as design, create, and/or troubleshoot integrations with third-party vendors.

 - Think beyond the code and about our customers, understand their needs and define solutions with the team;

 - Balance short-term speed of development with the long-term technical quality of our systems;

 - As a Senior Engineer, you will leverage your experience to guide the team in making informed technical decisions, such as continuous improvement of best practices (test culture, code reviews, monitoring and scalability of our tools). 



WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

 - Exposure to architectural patterns of a large, high-scale web application (e.g., well-designed APIs, high-volume data pipelines, efficient algorithms);

 - AI Expertise: You're a forefront user of Agentic AI. You're able to bring hands on experience and start influencing the team beyond code generation; reserving judgment for architecture, business logic, and security, using AI as a thought partner and able to set up quality gates and safety nets to enhance existing engineering workflows and propose AI-native alternatives.

 - Familiar and willing to support small JS/TS tasks when needed;

 - Expertise in troubleshooting issues, identifying the root cause, mitigating it, and adding setting up safeguards to prevent future issues;

 - High level of self-organization, ownership, and responsibility;

 - A great collaborator with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Minimum B2 English level;

 - Willingness to be on-call for your squad (1 week every 5 weeks).



WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT AT PREPLY

 - An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

 - A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com http://preply.com/, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;

 - A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

 - Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub;

 - Access to free mental health support platforms;

 - Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;

 - The opportunity to shape the lives of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


OUR PRINCIPLES

 - Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

 - We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

 - Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

 - Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

 - Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

 - Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

 - Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

 - Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

 - Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

 - One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

Preply.com http://Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

description:
What is Amplemarket all about?

Amplemarket's premise is that a lot of the playbooks used by B2B sales teams that worked 5 years ago don't cut it anymore.

In today's environment, sales teams need to have a tremendous amount of information about their prospects to decide when is the best moment and channel to reach out in the most relevant way. You can't do this with 5 different data/sales enablement point solutions that don't share the same data schema and barely communicate with each other. Amplemarket is the all-in-one compound solution that enables this.

Our AI-powered sales platform helps B2B companies generate more opportunities thanks to our advanced lead generation engine, hyper-personalized sequencing, omnichannel outreach, and AI-powered smart actions. We are backed by Y Combinator, and we are powering the sales teams at some of the fastest-growing companies in the world like Deel, Moveworks, H1 and Vanta.

This position is available for candidates based in EMEA, LATAM or North America.

Important Notice: Beware of Recruitment Scams

It has come to our attention that there are fraudulent activities targeting job seekers, where individuals are impersonating Amplemarket by using fake profiles, domains, and emails.
Please be informed that Amplemarket always uses our main domain (amplemarket.com) for all hiring and recruitment purposes. Any communication or offer not originating from an amplemarket.com email address should be regarded as suspicious.

- We will never request personal financial information (such as bank account details) during the initial application or interview process.

- Our hiring process does not involve transferring money or making payments of any kind to secure a position.

Amplemarket is not responsible for any loss or damage incurred as a result of job scams or fraudulent activity by third parties misusing our company name.

If you have any doubts about the legitimacy of a job opportunity with Amplemarket, please contact our HR department directly.

We advise you to verify the authenticity of any job-related communications claiming to be from Amplemarket. If you have any concerns or doubts, please contact us directly through our official channels.

Your security is our priority. Thank you for your vigilance and understanding.

Software engineers build the core of Amplemarket.

The three co-founders have an engineering background (João, Luís and Mica studied Physics & Computer Science at university) and deeply value the work that engineers are responsible for.

Our main goal is to build a sales platform that helps companies grow. Our product requires us to solve a myriad of difficult engineering problems very diverse in nature: from working on NLP models that can extract information from a thread of emails, to scaling an elasticsearch cluster holding terabytes of data.

We are deeply aware of the importance of our tool to our customers and look for people that share that vision.

Among other things, our stack includes: Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis

We don't require you to have experience in our stack to apply.

However, it's important to note that while this position primarily focuses on people and process management, there is a significant technical aspect we expect from candidates. The ideal candidate should possess the ability to work hands-on with the codebase when necessary, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting complex issues, and ensuring the overall quality and efficiency of our engineering efforts.

This role involves leading greenfield projects from the ground up, building new products that leverage Large Language Models and modern AI technologies, with meaningful ownership over both execution and technical direction.

Main Responsibilities:

- Report directly to the founders

- Provide leadership and mentorship to other engineers on the team

- Plan engineering sprints

- Recruit a robust team of engineers that are among the best in the industry, from outreach to closing

- Empower the engineering team to achieve a high level of technical productivity and quality

- Manage an excellent team of engineers, helping to develop their careers with stretch projects and excellent feedback

- Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as part of the engineering management team

Some more about Amplemarket:

- We are a post-Series A start-up

- Backed by YCombinator

- Strong technical founding team from MIT and IST (also founders of https://fermatslibrary.com/ )

- Fast growing startup with product market fit

- Great team spirit

We offer:

- Nice work environment

- Competitive Salary

- Health Insurance

- Stock Options

- Annual Company Trip in a secret location

- and more

Amplemarket is committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all.

Regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, or if you’re parenting the next generation of innovators, we firmly believe that what truly matters is how your skills, knowledge and personality fit our company. So bring your best professional version of yourself, and apply - we'd like to hear from you!

Amplemarket's premise is that a lot of the playbooks used by B2B sales teams that worked 5 years ago don't cut it anymore.

In today's environment, sales teams need to have a tremendous amount of information about their prospects to decide when is the best moment and channel to reach out in the most relevant way. You can't do this with 5 different data/sales enablement point solutions that don't share the same data schema and barely communicate with each other. Amplemarket is the all-in-one compound solution that enables this.

Our AI-powered sales platform helps B2B companies generate more opportunities thanks to our advanced lead generation engine, hyper-personalized sequencing, omnichannel outreach, and AI-powered smart actions. We are backed by Y Combinator, and we are powering the sales teams at some of the fastest-growing companies in the world like Deel, Moveworks, H1 and Vanta.

We’re looking for an Outbound Account Executive to join our team in Europe.
This is a high impact, net new business role for a seller who knows how to create pipeline, run a disciplined sales process, and close. You’ll be responsible for owning the full sales cycle from prospecting into target accounts to running discovery, demos, and negotiations through close.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced environment, enjoys the challenge of outbound, and wants meaningful ownership in a growing company. You’ll play an important role in expanding our presence across EMEA and helping us scale our go-to-market motion in the region.

You will:

- Own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through close

- Build and manage a healthy pipeline of net new opportunities across target accounts in EMEA

- Prospect through email, cold calls, LinkedIn, and other creative outbound channels

- Run strong discovery, demo, and evaluation processes with multiple stakeholders

- Clearly communicate Amplemarket’s value to sales leaders, revenue teams, and executive buyers

- Manage deal progression with rigor, including qualification, follow-up, objection handling, and next step precision

- Partner closely with leadership to refine messaging, outbound strategy, and territory execution

- Maintain strong CRM hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline discipline

- Share market feedback to help improve positioning, process, and product insight

What we’re looking for:

- 3+ years of experience as an Account Executive in B2B SaaS

- A track record of closing net-new business and consistently performing against quota

- Strong outbound prospecting skills and comfort generating your own pipeline

- Experience running full cycle sales motions from discovery through close

- Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills

- Confidence selling to multiple stakeholders, including managers, directors, VPs, and executives

- High ownership, strong urgency, and the ability to operate well in a fast-moving environment

- Curiosity, resilience, and a genuine interest in modern sales technology

- Ability to work effectively across EMEA markets and buying environments

Nice to have

- Experience selling sales tech, martech, RevTech, or adjacent SaaS products

- Experience selling into sales, growth, or revenue organizations

- Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Unify, 6sense, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, etc.

- Startup or high-growth company experience

Why join Amplemarket

- You’ll join a company with strong momentum, clear market relevance, and real product value

- You’ll sell a platform that sits at the center of a major shift in how sales teams operate

- You’ll have real ownership over your pipeline, deals, and impact

- You’ll work closely with experienced leaders and founders in a high performance environment

- You’ll help shape and grow our presence across EMEA

A little more about Amplemarket:

- We are a post-Series A start-up

- We are backed by YCombinator

- Fast growing startup with product market fit

- Founders also created https://fermatslibrary.com

- You can listen more about us here: https://bit.ly/2W7fVDR

We offer:

- Nice work environment

- Competitive Salary and Comission

- Health Insurance

- Stock Options

- Annual Company Trip in a secret location

- and more

Amplemarket is committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all.

Regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, or if you’re parenting the next generation of innovators, we firmly believe that what truly matters is how your skills, knowledge and personality fit our company. Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis

- When reviewing new system designs or code, you naturally think about what can go wrong: edge cases, failure modes, bottlenecks, migrations, releases, interesting metrics, etc

title: Android Developer
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel
At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.
Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.
We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.
Your Next Destination
Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
Contract:
Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
UK: Full-time, permanent
Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 
Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.
Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:
Life at Airalo · España: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-espana
Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom

You are someone who cares deeply about the quality of your work, the people who use it, and the team you build it with.

You take ownership of what you ship, from understanding why it matters to how it behaves once it's in people's hands, and you care whether it made a difference. You enjoy working closely with product managers, designers, QA and backend engineers: you ask questions early, share your ideas, and keep people in the loop so no one has to wonder where things stand.

You learn quickly, welcome feedback, and share what you learn with others. You use AI-assisted development with judgment, checking what it produces before you rely on it.

We are looking for an Android engineer to join the team building the Airalo app. You'll own features from idea to production with your product team, and grow your craft alongside the engineers in our Mobile guild.

What You'll Do:
- Own features end to end: shape them with Product and Design, build, test and release them, and follow how they perform with users

- Own the quality of your work in production: monitor stability and performance, investigate crashes and ANRs, and fix root causes

- Contribute to architecture discussions and build within the team's agreed patterns, proposing improvements when you see a better way

- Keep quality high through meaningful tests and thoughtful code reviews

- Plan and estimate your work, share progress proactively, and flag early when plans change

- Take part in product experiments and use what they show to improve the app

What You'll Bring:
- 4+ years of Android development in Kotlin, with production experience in Jetpack Compose

- Solid engineering fundamentals: clean, readable code, data structures and algorithms, design principles and testing

- Solid Android fundamentals: app lifecycle, concurrency, memory, performance and debugging

- Experience shipping and evolving apps at product companies, in cross-functional teams

- Ownership of your work: you organise it, get yourself unblocked through research, your team or the guild, and deliver what you commit to

- Hands-on AI-assisted development on real work: you validate what AI produces and understand the code you ship

- Clear written and spoken communication in English

Nice to have:

- Experience improving app stability and startup performance, including ANRs

- Experience with in-app payments or checkout flows

- Experience making apps reliable on poor or unstable connections

- Experience with Compose UI testing

- Experience building localized apps

At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍

📍 UK: £74,800 – £112,200
Your Home Destination: 🛫 Specific salary ranges used in offers are determined by where you reside. We’re committed to discussing these ranges openly during your first call with our Talent to ensure we’re aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨

Why People Join Us
🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain
We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.
Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.
For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.
🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK
We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.
Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.
As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.
Before You Hit Apply
By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel
At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.
Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead the global build and technical integration of Full MVNO systems. In this role, you will lead a dedicated Build Team responsible for architecting, integrating, testing, and commissioning end-to-end Full MVNO capabilities across global markets.
Operating under a Build-to-Run model, you and your team will build new MVNO capabilities and host MNO integrations from the ground up, execute rigorous testing, and hand over stable, operational systems to a dedicated Run team after launch. This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Mobile Core networks across voice, VoLTE, data, and SMS, strong knowledge of telecommunications regulations, and experience leading engineering and QA teams.

What You'll Do:
- Lead, mentor and manage a team of seven engineers, QA specialists and Site Reliability Engineers responsible for operating the Mobile Core Network across its full lifecycle, from design, build and deployment through steady-state operations, change management, incident response and upgrades.

- Manage the team’s work and people, covering sprint and capacity planning, prioritisation and stakeholder communication, alongside regular 1-to-1 meetings, fair and evidence-based performance reviews, and support for career growth.

- Establish engineering best practices, automated testing strategy and technical handover standards.

- Operate and manage the mobile core, built on a mix of CNFs and VNFs, from the subscriber database (HSS/HLR) through packet core, signalling (Diameter, SS7, DNS, GTP), voice and messaging platforms, ensuring end-to-end service readiness across data, voice and SMS, and working with NEPs, IPX/GRX partners, IaaS partners and Managed Service and SaaS providers.

- 2+ years leading a team of engineers and/or QA specialists in an agile or delivery-focused environment.

- Strong working knowledge of both packet core and voice core, including the subscriber database (HSS/HLR), policy and charging, VoLTE and legacy circuit-switched voice.

- Expertise across the signalling stack, including Diameter, SS7 and SIP.

- Experience with messaging architecture and SMS routing, including interworking with other operators.

- Strong delivery mindset across multiple concurrent rollout streams, with clear communication and the ability to produce documentation good enough to hand a system over on.

We are hiring the Procurement Lead to build the procurement function and policy from the ground up and drive standardization and savings across our largest spend categories: Networks, Sales & Marketing, and IT/Software.
You will design how Airalo buys, embed a disciplined purchase-to-pay process into our new ERP, and turn fragmented, function-by-function spending into a governed, competitive, and auditable process, and drive savings to every dollar we spend with third parties.
This is a senior role for a builder who will set the policy, run the high-value negotiations, and deliver hard savings that fund growth and protect EBITDA. You will report to the CFO and partner across every spending function in the company.

What you'll do:
Procurement policy & governance

- Design and roll out Airalo's procurement policy, delegation-of-authority thresholds, supplier onboarding, and competitive-tendering standards.

- Establish clear, proportionate approval workflows that bring control without slowing the business.

Category management

- Own the category strategies across the major spend areas: network and infrastructure spends, S&M (agencies, media, martech), IT and SaaS, and professional services.

- Build single source of truth with spends visibility and a vendor taxonomy so we know what we buy, from whom, and on what terms; build standardization and a framework to adhere to credit terms.

- Maintain a validated savings pipeline reported with Finance, and ensure segregation of duties, audit trail, and anti-fraud controls aligned to the SOX-lite framework.

Strategic sourcing & negotiation

- Lead competitive sourcing and high-value negotiations on a total-cost-of-ownership basis; set and deliver savings targets and improve working capital.

- Partner with Finance's zero-based budgeting and the process to convert sourcing wins into budgeted savings;

Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.

What You'll Do
- Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.

- Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.

- Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.

- Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team.

- Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision.

- Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty.

- Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back.

- Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation.

- Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims.

- Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance.

- Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch.

What You'll Bring
- 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions.

- Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks.

- Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming.

- Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data.

- Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns).

- Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker.

- Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering.

- Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap.

- Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale.

- Comfortable with ambiguity and with data that is still improving: you're a proactive self-starter who is happy to create a new process or capability in a small, fast-growing team.

- You communicate with confidence and humility. You can explain design decisions clearly to designers, engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders without becoming defensive.

- You raise the bar for the design community. You give thoughtful feedback, invite critique early, mentor others, and contribute to a Product Design Guild where designers learn and improve together.

- You are curious about AI and new ways of working. You actively explore how AI and emerging tools can improve design workflows, speed up learning, and help teams make better decisions.

This isn't for you if…
- You only want to design screens. This role requires shaping problems, influencing direction, collaborating across disciplines, and staying involved from discovery through delivery.

- You need certainty or close direction to make progress. Senior designers at Airalo are expected to move through ambiguity, create momentum, and make thoughtful decisions independently.

- You avoid feedback or critique. Our design culture depends on sharing unfinished work, challenging ideas respectfully, and changing direction when the evidence points elsewhere.

- You optimize for perfection over impact. We care deeply about quality, but we also need to make pragmatic decisions, learn quickly, and ship improvements.

- You are not interested in customers or the community. Speaking to customers, learning from them, and contributing to the Product Design Guild are central to how we build better products.

description:

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist, Pricing to build the analytical and machine learning capability that pricing runs on, from demand modelling through to the systems that recommend price.
You won't be starting from zero. We've invested in the foundational data and infrastructure that pricing decisions depend on. What's missing is the capability on top: models the business trusts, experiments that settle pricing questions with evidence, and economics defined once so they hold consistently across Commercial, Product and the customer experience.
The arc of the role runs from measurement to prediction to prescription - understanding how demand responds to price, forecasting how it will respond, and ultimately building the models that recommend the price itself.

What You'll Do:
-
Build and own the demand and elasticity modelling capability, quantifying how price affects volume across destination, duration, data tier, and customer segment.

-
Develop machine learning models for demand forecasting and willingness-to-pay, and take them from exploration through to production with the monitoring and retraining that keeps them honest.

-
Move us from predictive to prescriptive by building the optimisation layer that turns forecasts and elasticities into recommended prices under margin, competitive and partner constraints.

-
Design and analyse pricing experiments with statistical rigour, and apply causal methods where clean randomisation isn't possible.

-
Define pricing within our data ecosystem, owning the governed definitions of price, cost and package economics that reporting, analysis and product surfaces all read from.

-
Partner with Commercial and Finance to connect pricing decisions to margin and revenue, and to size opportunities before we commit.

-
Set the analytical standard for pricing at Airalo, from what counts as evidence through to how a model or recommendation gets validated before it influences live pricing.

What You'll Bring:
-
7+ years in data science, quantitative economics, or applied research, including pricing, monetisation, or marketplace economics work that demonstrably changed decisions.

-
Experience with dynamic or algorithmic pricing systems in production.

-
An advanced degree in Econometrics, Statistics, Operations Research or similar, or equivalent applied depth in demand estimation and the identification problems that make naive price-quantity regressions wrong.

-
Hands-on machine learning experience across the full lifecycle, from feature engineering and model selection through to deployment

-
Familiarity with optimisation and decision-science methods that turn predictions into recommended actions, whether through constrained optimisation, bandits, or reinforcement learning approaches.

-
Proven experimentation expertise, having designed and defended experiments with a clear view on decision frameworks and common failure modes.

-
Experience building analytical capability where none existed before, turning raw data and a business question into something a commercial team uses repeatedly.

-
Strong data modelling instincts, thinking in reusable definitions and single sources of truth rather than standalone analyses.

-
The ability to move comfortably between financial, product and operational data and connect the analysis to a financial outcome.

-
Genuine partnership instincts, translating between analytical rigour and commercial reality so that Commercial and Product come to you early rather than after the decision.

-
Fluency in the Python ML stack alongside strong SQL, with the engineering hygiene to hand over code that others can run and maintain.

-
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to make a methodological argument to people who won't check your standard errors.

-
A self-starter mindset that thrives in ambiguity and brings structure without waiting for permission.

-
Comfort using AI tools to augment analytical work, with a point of view on where they help and where they don't

Nice to have:
-
Experience in marketplace, telecom, travel, or subscription/usage-based businesses.

-
Bayesian or hierarchical modelling for sparse segments and long-tail SKUs.

-
Competitive price response modelling, or working with scraped competitor pricing data.

-
Familiarity with dbt, LightDash, or similar semantic/BI layers.

-
Experience designing semantic or metric layers consumed by both analytics and production systems.

-
Experience working in cross-functional teams spanning commercial, finance and product disciplines.

title: Director, Sales & Key Accounts, EMEA
location: Remote - UK, EMEA; London, Greater London, England, United Kingdom; Remote - Europe
description:
Core skills: business development, new logo acquisition, strategic account management, cross-sell, video infrastructure, executive engagement, pipeline generation, enterprise closing.

Bitmovin is an award-winning video streaming technology to world-renowned brands and managed service providers. Our solution suite consists of Live and VOD Encoding, a Multi-Platform Player, and Analytics platform; enabling content owners to redefine the viewer experience through API-based workflow optimization, fast turnaround, and scalability.

We have seen great success and created great momentum in the market. This is down to our products, ecosystem, but ultimately our people who love video streaming and helping customers.

“We’re building the future of video streaming across EMEA - combining high-impact hunting with strategic account growth to deliver unmatched commercial results. If you’re ready to help shape the industry and make a real impact, join us.”
Barney Withers Green, SVP, Sales & Business Development, EMEA & APAC

At Bitmovin we value cognitive diversity and the huge part this plays in not only creating a global culture second to none, but in how this underpins our ability to create truly representative, Emmy award winning products. Diversity in all its forms is encouraged and celebrated at Bitmovin; everyone has a role to play in helping us shape the future of video.

Why us?

Bitmovin is rapidly growing with significant market opportunity, and we are looking for talented and self driven individuals to take Bitmovin to the next level.

Following an exciting evolution of our commercial structure, we are seeking an exceptional, commercially driven Sales Director to accelerate revenue growth, develop strategic opportunities, and strengthen our presence across key EMEA markets.

This role uniquely combines high-impact new business development with strategic ownership of key customer relationships. Supported by designated Account Managers and Customer Success resources for day-to-day management, you will be empowered to focus on winning new logos, driving strategic cross-sell, and engaging executives across the region. With our full support and coaching, you will pave your own path, collaborating with our global teams to shape the future of media and streaming.

This is an opportunity that offers:

- Opportunity to shape the streaming and video technology strategies of leading EMEA Media & Entertainment companies

- A hybrid role balancing high-velocity new business acquisition with strategic key account ownership

- Selling market-leading products (Live Encoding, VOD Encoding, Player, Observability) alongside top Cloud Partners and System Integrators

- Autonomy, international collaboration, flexible working, and regional travel (~50%).

Your Impact

As Director, Sales & Key Accounts, you will be at the forefront of powering the next generation of digital video across EMEA. Your mission is to fuel Bitmovin’s expansion by acquiring game-changing new logos and driving high-value strategic growth across priority markets, including the UK, DACH, and selected CEE & MENA regions.

- Operating within the global GTM and partner strategy to define and execute local initiatives in media, streaming, and OTT markets.

- Driving direct enterprise sales with full sales cycle ownership, including multi-year SaaS agreements and platform licensing deals.

- Enabling customers to adopt Bitmovin solutions in the way that best fits their business — direct, partner-led, or cloud/video platform routes.

- Identifying, onboarding, and enabling local partners to drive net-new revenue and new customer wins.

- Collaborating with local and global teams (solutions engineering, customer success, partner teams) to support adoption and partner success.

- Providing market insights, competitor intelligence, and recommendations on product, pricing, and GTM strategy.

- Tracking pipeline, revenue, and partner acquisition KPIs to measure impact and improve conversion rates across channels.

What competencies can you bring

- Industry Expertise: Proven success selling software/technology into broadcasters, OTT platforms, or video infrastructure (CDN, adtech, broadcast tech)

- Drive & Accountability: Track record of originating, closing complex enterprise sales, and consistently exceeding revenue goals

- Relationship Building: Established network of technical and commercial decision-makers across EMEA media and streaming ecosystems

- Technical Acumen: Solid grasp of streaming workflows, technical ecosystems, and enterprise buying processes

- Proactive Ownership: Self-driven, highly autonomous pipeline builder focused on results and execution

- Strategic Influence: Confident navigating high-value negotiations and engaging senior executive stakeholders

- Collaboration & Adaptability: Open to feedback and skilled at partnering across cross-functional teams to drive collective success

What Success Looks Like

First 6 Months:

- Establish strong relationships with priority customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders

- Build a clear territory plan and strategic business development roadmaps for target regions

- Develop a healthy, self-generated pipeline of qualified opportunities

- Identify and progress strategic cross-sell opportunities within assigned key accounts

First 12 Months:

- Deliver against agreed net-new ARR and strategic cross-sell targets

- Demonstrate consistent pipeline generation and enterprise deal progression

- Establish meaningful new customer relationships across priority EMEA markets

- Maintain strong executive engagement and strategic oversight of assigned key accounts

- Operate independently with rigorous forecasting discipline and commercial accountability

You don’t have experience with all the points above? Don’t worry, we will support you with learning, training, and coaching on the job.
